title: PICARD Tutorial
text: tutorial shows structure project around PICARD. Terminology used tutorial: pipeline full orchestrated run across one top-level steps. step one top-level stage T2, T3, T4, T5. substep plain R script inside step, set_db.R. master runner script starts full pipeline. step runner script starts one step. audit means human-readable records written execution. logging means structured run step messages written LoggerManager. tutorial shows pieces fit together: master runner run/, YAML files pipeline, step, project configuration, one step runner per step (T2, T3, T4, T5), substep scripts stored transformations/<step>/source_code, shared functions shared configuration outside package, substeps use PICARD orchestration, config loading, /O, SQL, audit, logging.

text: Create run/run_pipeline.R: : configures run logger, instantiates master pipeline, loads YAML files objects config_pipeline config_project, sources configured step runner order.
code: #!/usr/bin/env Rscript  lm <- picard::LoggerManager$new() lm$configure(log_dir = "logs", verbose = "Normal")  pipeline <- picard::pipeline$new(   config_pipeline = "configuration/config_pipeline.yaml" )  picard::load_config() pipeline$run()

title: PICARD Tutorial
text: Create run/run_T2_pipeline.R: slightly robust bare project runner pattern works : sourced run_pipeline.R, executed directly T2-development. T3, T4, T5, use runner pattern instantiate matching class step config, example picard::t3_pipeline$new(config_t3 = "configuration/config_T3.yaml").
code: #!/usr/bin/env Rscript  if (   !base::exists("lm", inherits = TRUE) ||     !base::inherits(lm, "LoggerManager") ) {   lm <- picard::LoggerManager$new()   lm$configure(log_dir = "logs", verbose = "Normal") }  lm$start_step_logger("T2") on.exit(lm$end_step_logger(), add = TRUE)  pipeline <- picard::t2_pipeline$new(   config_t2 = "configuration/config_T2.yaml",   config_project = "configuration/config_project.yaml",   skip_substeps = TRUE )  # Optional: call pipeline$clean() if you want to clear the T2 intermediate # folder before the run and cleanup.intermediate_data_file is true.  pipeline$run()

code: if (   !base::exists("lm", inherits = TRUE) ||     !base::inherits(lm, "LoggerManager") ) {   lm <- NULL }  if (!base::is.null(lm)) {   lm$start_script("processing_persons.R")   lm$start_capturing_prints() }  picard::load_config()  picard::audit_start(   file_name = "d3_persons",   deap_name = config_project$DEAP_configuration$name )  dir_d2_db <- config_pipeline$databases$dir_d2_db output_path <- config_project$processing_persons$output_persons  ... ... ...  picard::save(persons, output_path)  picard::audit_add("Rows exported: ", nrow(persons)) picard::audit_end()  if (!base::is.null(lm)) {   lm$stop_capturing_prints()   lm$end_script() }

title: Tools for Coordinating Modular R Scripts in a Data Transformation Pipeline
text: PICARD R orchestration package configuration-driven clinical data pipelines. designed : - Run multi-step transformation flows (T2, T3, T4, T5) reproducible way. - Separate orchestration logic project-specific transformation scripts. - Provide consistent logging, auditing, file /O utilities. PICARD implement project transformations directly. executes existing transformation scripts order conditions declared YAML configuration files.

title: Tools for Coordinating Modular R Scripts in a Data Transformation Pipeline
text: PICARD helps teams keep pipelines reliable keeping project flexible: - Stable orchestration layer package. - Flexible project logic standalone scripts. - Config-driven execution repeatability traceability.

title: Tools for Coordinating Modular R Scripts in a Data Transformation Pipeline
text: pipeline configured using YAML files. high-level step (T2/T3/T4/T5) contains multiple substeps. Every substep plain R script can run independently. PICARD executes substeps marked enabled config.

title: Tools for Coordinating Modular R Scripts in a Data Transformation Pipeline
text: Loads YAML files. Runs full pipeline steps via run(). Runs substeps via run_substeps(). Optionally skips completed substeps skip_step(). Step-specific wrappers load step configs execute configured substeps. load() save() provide extension-based readers/writers. register_reader() / register_writer() allow custom formats. list_readers() / list_writers() show available formats. load_sql_query() reads SQL files interpolates parameters. execute_sql_file() executes queries DBI connections. audit_start(), audit_add(), audit_end() human-readable audit files. LoggerManager structured run step logging.

title: picard (development version)
text: CI now runs shared workflows rwe-ecosystem @v2 single .github/workflows/ci.yaml (R CMD check, lint Air formatting, coverage, pkgdown). Code formatted Air instead styler; air.toml managed rwe-ecosystem must edited (CI fails differs). Run air format . pushing. Formatting , behaviour changes. .lintr: indentation_linter stays (Air owns layout) long lines allowed tests/testthat (long test_that() descriptions). R/run_logger.R: # nolint LoggerManager moved # nolint next line, since Air moves trailing comments. Documentation regenerated roxygen2 8.1.0. Adopted rwe-ecosystem starter files: .gitignore (now also shares .vscode/settings.json .vscode/extensions.json), .Rbuildignore entries, .covrignore (excludes R/deprecated.R R/zzz.R coverage), _pkgdown.yml, pull request template. .vscode/settings.json sets Air R formatter format save; .vscode/extensions.json recommends Air R extensions. DESCRIPTION: added URL (GitHub repository pkgdown site) BugReports. Added .git-blame-ignore-revs, git blame GitHub’s blame view skip formatting-commits migration. CHANGELOG.md renamed NEWS.md (pkgdown format: # picard <version> headings), ships package (utils::news(package = "picard")) shown pkgdown site’s Changelog page. Release links GitHub releases page.

title: picard 1.2.5
text: analyze_pipeline_log() (R/post_run_analysis.R): parses pipeline log produces run/level/alert/step/script/gap summary tables plus diagnostic plots (level_summary, step_summary, script_summary, step_timeline, script_timeline, gap_summary), written analysis/<log_name> folder next log. start_script_logging() / stop_script_logging() exported log_trace/log_debug/log_info/log_success/log_warn/log_error/log_fatal wrappers (R/logging_helpers.R), project scripts can log picard without depending logger directly. become -ops pipeline already owns logging context. track_file_changes() gained only_format/exclude_format arguments include exclude files extension hashing (mutually exclusive). Colourised console log output, new SUCCESS log level used final “Pipeline completed successfully” message. TUTORIAL.md, full walkthrough terminology section; README.md significantly expanded.

title: picard 1.2.5
text: CSV reading now goes data.table::fread (R/load.R) instead base/utils readers. Reworked yaml/sql loading internals (dispatch_reader, load_raw, prepare_load_request R/load.R/R/load_sql_query.R), replacing old get_tracked_files path. DESCRIPTION: License switched file LICENSE standard GPL-3 specifier, Depends bumped R (>= 4.1.0), dropped dependency, cleaned Title/Description text, migrated Config/roxygen2/version (roxygen2 8.0.0). General CRAN-compliance pass across R/Pipeline.R, R/audit.R, R/run_logger.R, R/save.R, R/plot_data.R, R/delete_data.R, R/utils.R, .Rbuildignore, .gitignore. step_timeline/script_timeline plots now order steps/scripts chronologically actual start time instead alphabetically.

title: picard 1.2.5
text: .parse_log_line() (R/post_run_analysis.R): “High” verbosity regex required trailing | <hash> field; log lines empty message (e.g. stray ANSI colour code) omitted field silently fell back mismatched pattern, corrupting parsed step column. hash field now optional regex. CSV loading longer raises spurious row-count-mismatch error nrow/nrows/skip passed limit rows read. CSV reader longer leaks data.table::fread’s “Stopped early line …” warning ragged/corrupt CSVs; existing row-count check already raises clearer error case. LoggerManager gained reset() method, .reset_logger_manager_instance() now uses clear exported logger_manager singleton’s fields logger::log_appender()/log_layout()/log_threshold() registrations place, instead discarding internal cache reference exported binding never actually pointed . Previously, test (code) configured LoggerManager left shared logger namespace registrations dangling deleted log file rest R session, causing unrelated failures next time full test suite ran.
